submission.justification: K1 has the best resolution (2.9% in the 2025 summary at 5 cm), but its intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day. That is 4 times the 0.5 budget, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. K3 has the lowest background (0.10) but a resolution of about 8.5%. K2 meets the budget at 0.30 and gives the best resolution of the compliant candidates. I simulated K2 at 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 cm and the minimum was 4.38% at 5 cm. I did not re-simulate K1 or K3, and the K3 figure comes from the 2025 summary.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K2 at 5 cm gives 4.38% FWHM, the best of the candidates that meet the background budget. K1 would be better (2.9%, 2025 summary) but fails the background budget.
K2 assay is 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day. K1 is 2.0, which fails.
